blocks.label: THE RACE
blocks.text:
Execute the plan:
• Start conservative — do NOT redline the first SkiErg or run
• Negative-split if you can; pick it up in the back half
• Break wall balls into planned sets from rep 1 (e.g. 10s)
• Doubles: take the bigger share on sleds, wall balls, lunges; keep swaps clean
Trust the work you put in. Have fun out there.
